qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unmatched global CPG scale across 180+ countries (CHF 89.5B-89.9B FY25 sales) anchored by high-margin category leaders in Coffee (28.1% of sales, 17.2% UTOP margin; Nescafé, Nespresso proprietary capsule system, Starbucks), PetCare (20.6%, 21.7% UTOP margin; Purina Pro Plan/ONE), and Nutrition & Health Science (16.0%, 19.5% UTOP margin), reinforced by CHF 1.61B/yr R&D and grocery shelf dominance. Empirical proof: company-reported ROIC stayed >=12.2% every year 2019-2025 (12.2%-14.1%, FY25 12.7%); Yahoo 4Y median GAAP ROIC is 13.1% and Tangible Operating ROIC is 34.9% (30.1%-40.3% FY22-FY25); gross margin held 45.4%-46.9% through historic coffee and cocoa inflation; and Real Internal Growth (RIG) accelerated from +0.2% (H1 25) to +1.4% (H2 25), +1.5% (H1 26), and +2.8% (Q3 2026; +4.0% organic growth), led by PetCare (+5.3% OG, +4.3% RIG). Primary erosion threats: private-label pressure in Zone Europe (+1.2% Q3 26 OG) and US frozen/mainstream food, cocoa/coffee cost volatility, GLP-1/UPF shifts in confectionery/prepared dishes, and brand-trust erosion from the 2026 infant formula recall and Perrier filtration probes.
qualitative.calamity_note: (1) Broken metrics (Gates 5 & 6): Legacy Schneider-era capital allocation destroyed value via CHF 20B debt-funded buybacks (2022-2024) at CHF 106.74 avg price and ~$8.8B Health Science/coffee M&A missteps (Bountiful $5.75B -> mainstream VMS sold for $1.0B with CHF 1.3B H1 26 impairment; Aimmune $2.6B; Blue Bottle $425M -> sold <$400M), plus 5 consecutive years of CHF 0.89B-3.34B/yr special/restructuring charges (CHF 1.70B FY25; CHF 2.1B H1 26), 12,000 white-collar roles of bureaucratic bloat, two CEO exits in 13 months (Laurent Freixe fired Sep 1, 2025 for undisclosed subordinate relationship), Perrier filtration raids, and the delayed Nov 2025-Jan 2026 cereulide infant formula recall Paris judicial probe (CHF 185M direct hit). On Gate 6, repeatable GAAP Owner EPS fell below prior peaks (CHF 4.30 [2019] / CHF 4.23 [2023] -> CHF 3.51 [FY25] and CHF 1.35 basic EPS [-31.4% YoY] in H1 26), LT Debt (CHF 46.25B) is 5.12x FY25 NI (CHF 9.03B) and Net Debt (CHF 51.38B Dec 25 / CHF 56.3B Jun 26 post-dividend) is 5.69x-6.23x NI (>4.0x ceiling) with -CHF 11.50B tangible equity, CHF 11.61B ST debt, and an S&P AA- Negative Outlook (Oct 27, 2025) at ~2.9x-3.0x Adj. Debt/EBITDA as growing CHF 7.85B-8.0B dividends absorb ~80-87% of FCF. (2) Intact moat & unit economics: Core Coffee, PetCare, and Nutrition engines generate 34.9% Tangible Operating ROIC, 45.8%-46.9% gross margins, 113.1% 4Y Owner FCF conversion (FY25 Yahoo FCF CHF 10.99B / company FCF CHF 9.15B; H1 26 FCF +46.3% YoY to CHF 3.38B; FY26E FCF >CHF 9.0B), 6.90x EBIT/Interest (7.67x OpInc/Interest), Aa3 (Moody's Stable) / AA- credit access, and an unencumbered 20.1% L'Oréal stake (~CHF 36B+ / ~$47B) + 50% Froneri stake (~EUR 15B EV), while Q3 2026 OG (+4.0%) and RIG (+2.8%) confirm volume recovery. (3) Fix catalyst & kill-switch: New Chairman Pablo Isla (ex-Inditex, late 2025) and CEO Philipp Navratil (Sep 2025) + CFO Anna Manz halted buybacks (CHF 213M FY25 vs ~CHF 5B/yr FY23-24), launched Fuel for Growth (16,000 cuts incl. 12,000 white-collar for CHF 3.0B annual savings by end-2027), consolidated Health Science into 4 core categories, and signed ~CHF 3.7B+ cash divestments closing H1 2027 (Peranel 50:50 Waters JV with Platinum Equity for ~EUR 3.0B / ~CHF 2.8B cash; mainstream VMS sale to Yellow Wood for $1.0B / ~CHF 0.9B; plus remaining ice cream transfer to Froneri and Blue Bottle café exit). KILL-SWITCH (by FY2028 results / Feb 2029): Permanently reject if Net Debt/normalized Owner Earnings fails to fall <=4.0x (and S&P Adj. Debt/EBITDA <=2.6x) by FY2028, if divestment proceeds or FCF are diverted to buybacks/M&A before hitting <=4.0x Net Debt/OE, if continuing-ops Owner EPS fails to surpass the CHF 4.30 (2019) / CHF 4.23 (2023) peak with RIG >=2.0% by FY2028, or if Paris formula/Perrier probes trigger >CHF 1.0B cumulative penalties or structural Nutrition share loss.

qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle financials (2016-H1 2026): Company-reported ROIC (after goodwill/intangibles) held 12.2%-14.1% across 2019-2025 (12.3%, 12.2%, 12.2%, 12.2%, 13.9%, 14.1%, 12.7%); Yahoo metrics.py 4Y median GAAP ROIC is 13.14% (FY22 11.9%, FY23 15.0%, FY24 14.2%, FY25 12.1%) and Tangible Operating ROIC is 34.87% (33.5%, 40.3%, 36.3%, 30.1%). Gross margins held 45.4% (FY22), 46.1% (FY23), 46.9% (FY24), and 45.8% (FY25). Net Profit moved from CHF 12.61B (2019) and CHF 16.91B (2021, boosted by partial L'Oréal disposal gain) to CHF 9.27B (2022), CHF 11.21B (2023), CHF 10.88B (2024), and CHF 9.03B (2025; H1 2026 CHF 3.47B after CHF 1.3B held-for-sale write-down and CHF 0.8B restructuring). Diluted/Owner EPS peaked at CHF 4.30 (2019) and CHF 4.233 (2023) before falling to CHF 4.188 (2024), CHF 3.507 (2025), and CHF 1.35 basic EPS (-31.4% YoY; Underlying EPS CHF 2.22) in H1 2026. Multi-year FCF conversion is 113.1% (4Y metrics.py Owner FCF/NI: FY22 88.9%, FY23 110.1%, FY24 119.2%, FY25 134.4%; Yahoo FCF CHF 10.99B in FY25; company FCF CHF 9.15B FY25 and CHF 3.38B H1 2026, +46.3% YoY; FY26E >CHF 9.0B). FY25 category mix (CHF 89.49B company-reported; CHF 89.89B Yahoo total revenue): Powdered & Liquid Beverages CHF 25.14B (28.1%, 17.2% UTOP), PetCare CHF 18.41B (20.6%, 21.7% UTOP), Nutrition & Health Science CHF 14.30B (16.0%, 19.5% UTOP), Prepared Dishes & Cooking Aids CHF 10.11B (11.3%, 19.7% UTOP), Milk Products & Ice Cream CHF 9.70B (10.8%, 23.0% UTOP), Confectionery CHF 8.70B (9.7%, 12.7% UTOP), Water CHF 3.13B (3.5%, 9.2% UTOP); group UTOP margin 16.1% FY25 -> 16.4% H1 2026. Organic growth / RIG momentum: FY25 +3.5% OG (+0.8% RIG, +2.8% price; -5.7% FX), H1 2026 +3.6% OG (+1.5% RIG, +2.1% price; -6.2% FX), 9M 2026 +3.7% OG (+1.9% RIG, +1.8% price), Q3 2026 +4.0% OG (+2.8% RIG, +1.1% price) led by PetCare (+5.3% OG, +4.3% RIG), Food & Snacks (+5.0% OG), Coffee (+3.4% OG), and Waters (+12.3% OG). Capital allocation & balance sheet: 2022-2024 CHF 20B buyback at CHF 106.74 avg price (cut share count 2.93B [2019] -> 2.57B [2025]; paused to CHF 213M in FY25) plus Health Science M&A bloated Net Debt from CHF 32.9B (2021) to CHF 56.0B (2024), CHF 51.38B (Dec 2025, aided by ~CHF 2B Froneri distribution), and CHF 56.3B (Jun 2026 post CHF 8.0B dividend). FY25 LT Debt CHF 46.25B (5.12x NI), Total Debt CHF 57.85B (incl. CHF 11.61B ST debt), Cash+STI CHF 5.93B, TBV -CHF 11.50B, EBIT/Interest 6.90x (12.57B/1.82B), FY25 Net Debt/EBITDA 2.85x (S&P AA- Negative Outlook Oct 27, 2025 at ~2.9x-3.0x; Moody's Aa3 Stable). Strategic unbundling & restructuring: Isla/Navratil reset cut 16,000 roles (CHF 3B savings by end-2027), signed Peranel 50:50 Waters JV with Platinum Equity (EUR 4.9B EV, ~EUR 3.0B / ~CHF 2.8B cash, H1 2027 close), sold mainstream VMS to Yellow Wood Partners ($1.0B, H1 2027 close), transferring <CHF 1B ice cream to Froneri, sold Blue Bottle cafés (<$400M), deconsolidated Russia (Sep 2026), and retains 20.1% of L'Oréal (~CHF 36B+ / ~$47B) while navigating Perrier/Vittel raids and the Jan 2026 infant formula cereulide recall (CHF 185M direct hit, Paris judicial probe).
